source_locator: Return sheet dated December 17, 2010, Mayor rows; Resolution 2010-R-108 page 1 summary report
verification_note: The Webb County Elections Administrator certified the return sheet for the City of Laredo runoff on December 17, 2010, and the council canvassed it by Resolution 2010-R-108. Salinas 12,783 (66.03 percent) and Belmares 6,575 (33.97 percent), total 19,358. The November 2, 2010 general election was the earlier round.

source_locator: Item IV.1, Resolution 2014-R-111, Mayor results table, total column
verification_note: The city secretary read the results at the November 12, 2014 canvass and council approved Resolution 2014-R-111. Saenz received 12,831 votes (53.34 percent), a majority under Charter section 10.4, so no mayoral runoff followed. The runner-up Jerry Garza had 4,924, ahead of Cindy Liendo with 4,587. Totals are early voting plus election day.

source_locator: Item VI.2, Resolution 2018-R-169, runoff canvass table, Mayor rows
verification_note: Council canvassed the December 13, 2018 runoff by Resolution 2018-R-169. Saenz 13,978 (64.49 percent) and Roque Vela Jr. 7,698 (35.51 percent). In the November 6, 2018 general election Saenz had 21,864 (47.68 percent), short of a majority, which caused the runoff.

source_locator: Attachment to Resolution 2022-R-212, Returns Sheet, Mayor rows
verification_note: Council canvassed the returns on December 28, 2022 (Resolution 2022-R-212; minutes M2022-SC-09). The returns sheet gives Treviño 8,435 and Martinez 7,171, read by optical character recognition of a scanned page; the second figure printed as 7, 17 1. The Webb County summary report of election night, labeled unofficial, gives 8,419 and 7,154, and is lower by a few votes. The official canvass figures are used. The first round on November 8, 2022 was an earlier round.
